Scenario fixture: slider-name-present (input[type=range] / role="slider" must have an accessible name)

Each target element has a stable id of the form slider_case_NN. Two "kinds" are covered: native input[type=range] (supports <label> association), and role="slider" (name-from-author-only per WAI-ARIA: no content fallback, and — unlike the native control — no <label> fallback either, since the rule only applies native-label resolution to the native-slider kind).

A. Native input[type=range]: mechanism priority order

01 — OUT OF SCOPE: native range with no explicit role; form-control-programmatic-label-present reports it
02 — PASS: native range, aria-label
03 — PASS: native range, aria-labelledby
Brightness
04 — PASS: native range, title
05 — PASS: native range, native <label for>
06 — PASS: native range, wrapping <label>
07 — OUT OF SCOPE: native range with no explicit role, aria-label empty; form-control-programmatic-label-present reports it

B. role="slider": author-only-name, no content, no label fallback

08 — FAIL: role=slider, no name at all
09 — FAIL: role=slider, visible content only (does NOT count)
Volume
10 — FAIL: role=slider, wrapped by <label> (does NOT count for aria-slider kind)
11 — PASS: role=slider, aria-label
12 — PASS: role=slider, aria-labelledby
Speed
13 — PASS: role=slider, title

C. Visible but excluded from AT (ineligible)

14 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: role=slider, aria-hidden="true", not focusable, missing name
15 — NEUTRAL: role=slider, aria-hidden="true" and focusable => out of scope here; aria-hidden-focus reports this markup

D. Hidden by HTML/CSS (ineligible)

16 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: hidden attribute
17 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: display:none
18 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: visibility:hidden
19 — EXCEPTION: visibility:hidden ancestor overridden by descendant visibility:visible => eligible, missing name => FAIL

E. Inertness (ineligible)

20 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: inert on element itself
21 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: inert ancestor

Native label association (input[type=range] only -- role="slider" is name-from-author-only and never resolves via <label>, see the "kind" branch in evaluate(); getNativeLabelText's closest('label')/label[for]-map fallback branches are consequently unreachable for THIS rule specifically, unlike its listbox/searchbox/spinbutton/textbox/combobox siblings, since a native-slider is always a real, natively-labelable <input> whose .labels API already resolves both wrapping and for= association)

22 — PASS: label[for] on a native input[type=range]; the label's own content is empty, so its name falls back to its title attribute
23 — FAIL: role="slider" (not a native input[type=range]) is name-from-author-only -- a wrapping <label> does NOT give it a name

End of fixture.
